content.title: Validate Status filter dropdown shows label instead of raw value
content.description:
Validate the fix for parent mqgxk7rj2a (Dev task mqgznigv4t).

- Filtering behavior is unchanged (cosmetic-only fix).

Reproduce-then-verify: the original reproduction (trigger shows 'closed' for /?status=closed) is documented in review mqgxnab1q9; confirm the fix resolves it.
